description.en: Registers a named rectangular floor-attribute zone on the match field, by name and a min/max XZ bounding box (e.g. a special-terrain area the match logic can query by name).
Name to register the zone under (e.g. "FL01").
Minimum X coordinate of the zone.
Minimum Z coordinate of the zone.
Maximum X coordinate of the zone.
Maximum Z coordinate of the zone.
True once the zone has been registered; null if fewer than 5 arguments were given.
